solution:
The correct answer is __A-S ; B-R ; C-Q ; D-P__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Trimmed sizes__ are standard dimensions used for paper sheets.
 
• Sizes are based on international standards (ISO 216).
 
• The series starts with A0, the largest size, and subsequent sizes are created by halving the previous one.
 
• For instance, the size of A1 is half of A0, and A2 is half of A1.
 
• Standard sizes include A4 (210 × 297 mm), A3 (297 × 420 mm), etc.
 
• The given options correctly match specific designations with their trimmed sizes.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **ISO 216 Standard:**

 
 
• Defines the dimensions for paper sizes, including the A, B, and C series.
 
• It is widely used internationally.
 
 
 
• **Applications:**
 
 
• Used for printing, publishing, and document standardization globally.
 
• The A4 size is commonly used for letters and documents.
